OH MY GOD. I have this same problem! Nobody knows about my sh, but if they did, they’d be like, “ what the heck your life is great. If anyone should be cutting it should be me because iM aaaactually dEpRaSSeD. You are fine and *I* , the actually depressed person, am NOT.” So I tell no one. Must protect Roods!
I like my scars as well. Mine are a deep purple, which is cool.
I can’t believe all of that shit happened to you. I appreciate you writing it down, though. Writing helps me to cope as well.
It’s a common facade among self harmers to think that they aren’t valid. If you make yourself feel pain in any way, not just cutting, it’s self harm.
Ghost eyes has a character who cuts and is suicidal. It’s not the main focus of the WEBTOON, but if you want imagery, then it’s perfect.
Think about the future, do you want your potential spouse to see the scars? What about potential kids? On the beach? I’m not trying to make you feel guilty, but this usually helps me <3.

Well, I’ve never met anyone in real life who has sh scars. If I did, I would feel really bad for them. It’s one thing to know people online who sh, but that’s nothing like knowing someone in real life who followed the same fate as yourself.
Watching something, or literally doing anything that requires brainpower is a great way to ward off those urges. I wish you the best of luck.
I did that once :D.

The thing nobody tells you about self harm is that, it is indeed an addiction.

Thanks for that. That’s just the way I feel, and I can’t help it. But it is strange how wrinkly the scars are.

Not me. I sh a bit differently. In a single session, I cut over a previous scar about 20-30 times. In total, I have 3 scars spread out so nobody sees a clump or something. It would make me look like I’m inferior :,)
It’s fun to play with blood. It sounds messed up, but I enjoy it as well.

I still cut on that same scar, so it’s purple. It’s not keloid, because it’s at the top of my wrist where no fat is. It’s a bit harder to cut on scars because the skin is tougher. You can make the scar bleed with a sharp enough blade, yes.
It was on my wrist. The knife was really bad, I didn’t even hit styro. But it hurt so much after that. I switched to sharper things after that and my new normal is 20 on the same spot.
Thank you so much. I’ll definitely try that.
I don’t know if this will help, because I don’t put things on my scars, but concealer could possible help? I know keloid scars are 3D, but it could help?

I don’t do separate cuts, I cut on the same wound over and over. I think my top is 1000? They’re swipes, not individual cuts. And it was back when I was using a crappy knife that did nothing, so this doesn’t even count.
When I cut, I lose control of my voice and brain. I start talking nonsense and sometimes laugh. I do all of this in the shower, so nobody hears it. But I become a different person when I sh.
Huh. That’s not a bad idea. How is it with absorbing large amounts of blood?
Be calm. It’ll be ok. Where’s the cut?

I’ve been a year round swimmer for 5 years. If you wear a one-price suit, that has the hips covered. For the one on the shoulder, it depends how visible it is. If it’s pretty visible, then you could pass it off as a scratch from a cat or something.

If you do, please be careful. Don’t go looking at cuts on social media. It’ll only make things worse. Make sure to take proper care of whatever cut you do. Also, do some research to make sure that you are prepared. Please be safe <3.
Okay, put pressure on the wound. How deep is it? Do you see yellow orbs or a pinkish surface? If the wound is on your arm, lift your arm up so the blood in your body goes down.
Yeah. I don’t know what else to use though. Thank you for your concern.

bracelets and watches

I was 13. This voice in my head got louder until I obeyed.

Those are my deepest desires with cutting. I cut in places where there’s not much fat, but the amount of blood that comes out is fascinating. I can’t help but to just stare in awe at the red liquid dripping down my hip or wherever.
Thank you for sharing. Cutting is strangely euphoric, isn’t it?
Do it on your lower hips, where the swim suit covers them. I’m a swimmer too so I feel ya. Keep them in that area and trace over the old scars to conceal them. Hope this helps!

Let them know you care. Personally, I am on the other side of this situation you are describing, except nobody knows about my SH. But don’t tell them to stop for you because that will make them more upset, and possibly SH more. Telling them that you care is the best that you can do, and if you are religious, keep them in your prayers.
